# Loan Portfolio Optimization and Collateral Management

This document details key actions required for effective loan portfolio management, focusing on optimization and risk mitigation.

## Key Action Items:

*   Optimize interest rates based on audit recommendations.
*   Monitor collateral value based on audit findings.
*   Review collateral value quarterly.
*   Urgently update collateral value as needed.
*   Monitor borrower credit scores for the 2026 strategy.
